definitions.gloss: time card; punch card for tracking work hours
definitions.explanation: A paper or digital card used to record the times an employee starts and ends work. Inserted into a time clock that stamps the time.

examples.japanese: {出勤時|しゅっきんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧タイムカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: I punch the time card when I come in to work.

examples.japanese: タイムカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧、⟦{手書|てが}き→手書き：08301_tegaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to punch the time card, so I recorded it by hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧タイムカード⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かわり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勤怠|きんたい}→勤怠：07731_kintai⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more companies are managing attendance with smartphones instead of time cards.

notes:
From English 'time card'. Refers to both physical paper cards and the digital equivalents used by modern attendance systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タイムカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to punch a time card (verb ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ is standard)
- タイムカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to clock in/out (alternative phrasing)
- タイムカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to stamp the time card
